dependencies.python: numpy/scipy not required: fit the logistic with a short numpy Newton or grid search; matplotlib for charts. No new dependencies.

story-context.constraints: - No kernel/ or protocol/ changes. PHASE_ORDER_VERSION stays 1. - scenario_hash of every scenario unchanged; run-vs-rerun byte tests unchanged. - Charts read mc.parquet + manifest only; no scenario re-runs inside chart code. - Nominal ratio denominator = defender budget + redemption reserves (probe_boundary.resources); absorbed ratio denominator = defender_bought_stable + holder_bought_stable + redemption_paid_total. - No hand-tuning of axes to make a contour appear; the AC 3 extension rule is the only permitted change, and it is reported. - Python 3.12-compatible.
